scope: Walking, running, facing, removal of legacy models, runtime optimization and server-authoritative collision

observedRoutes: NPC route avoided scenery and entered the bridge

multiplayerAudit.method: Four actual WebSocket clients plus one browser player; checks use the same measured collision proxy shapes, not mesh-triangle intersections

collision.camera: Analytic obstacle intersections replace invisible box meshes. Shoulder offset reduces near obstacles; character remained visible in inspected close-hut view at camera distance 3.68 m.

failureTest.method: Isolated temporary proxy returned HTTP 503 for the world asset catalog; real assets were untouched
failureTest.visibleResult: 3D loading error overlay; no primitive replacement
failureTest.cleanup: Temporary proxy exited and failure-test browser tab closed

noFallback.modelReview: Failed model load clears the previous model and disables playback

other: Distance-based vegetation LOD and near-tree shadows
Removed duplicate grass LOD and invisible camera geometry
Unchanged resource/camp/NPC data omitted from movement snapshots
ETag and HTTP 304 for unchanged files

comparison.kind: Spot observations, not a controlled FPS benchmark; actor poses and other browser load may differ
comparison.conclusion: Observed rendering workload decreased; FPS improvement is not demonstrated. Heap values exclude GPU memory.

limitations: Huts have solid exterior footprints; interiors are not accessible.
Mammoth circles are conservative and prevent entry into narrow gaps.
Collision is kinematic horizontal movement plus terrain height, not ragdolls, jumping or full rigid-body dynamics.
Asset files and image-to-3D provenance are unchanged; optimization reduces runtime workload rather than further simplifying exported meshes.
Existing close-view image-to-3D art imperfections remain.
Five local connections were tested; this is not an internet or multiple-device load test.
